title: Welcome. Your job in one line

steps.text: Maria sees a home online. She taps **Contact agent**. One minute later, her phone rings. Who is calling? **You.**
You are an **ISA**: an inside sales agent. You call leads. You set appointments for an agent.

cards.back: A person who asked about a home.
The US agent or team you work for.
A set day and time to meet the agent.
You! You call leads and book appointments.

steps.why: The agent sells homes. You book the agent's appointments.

steps.text: You set the appointment. The agent does the rest.
steps.sub: That is how you both win.

steps.text: **LockedIn VAs** is your company. We train you, pay you and help you. Your **coordinator** is your helper there.

cards.back: Your LockedIn VAs helper. Tell them problems first.
The agent. They give you the daily work.
The one chat where you and your client talk.

steps.says: Hey, send me your WhatsApp. It's easier.

options.why: No private chats. Your coordinator cannot see them.

options.text: Thanks, Mark! Let's keep it in our channel.
options.why: Kind and clear. Everything stays in one place.

steps.text: All client talk stays in the client channel.
steps.sub: Your coordinator can see it and help you.

steps.q: Your internet stops working. Who do you tell first?
steps.why: Your coordinator helps you. Tell them at once.

steps.text: You are paid **once a month**, in **US dollars**. You are paid for your **tracked hours**. A tool named Hubstaff tracks them.

steps.why: LockedIn VAs bills the client and pays you. Simple.

steps.q: Your pay looks wrong. Who do you ask?
steps.why: Never ask the client about pay. Your coordinator checks it.

steps.text: 12 short chapters. One day. You tap, flip, sort and speak. Each chapter ends with 5 quick questions.

steps.q: You tap a wrong answer. What happens?
steps.why: Wrong taps help you learn. No stress.

steps.line: Hi Maria, this is Sofia with Dana Lee's team.

steps.text: A great ISA calls **fast** and is kind. A great ISA asks easy questions. Then asks for the appointment. Then writes a note.

steps.q: What does a great ISA do?
options: Calls fast and asks for the appointment
Waits for leads to call back
steps.why: Fast, kind, and always asks for a day and time.

steps.sub: Asking is smart. Guessing is risky.
